purpose: CR-2 fixed-probe synthetic wiring: records the six pinned vendor sources copied byte-exact from the fixed Git commit 558b9c864a4b820e397336200758b143556a4d87 into this vendor directory. Contains no configuration, credentials, certificates, secrets or device data.
notes: All six files were extracted from the fixed Git commit via git checkout of the pinned tree paths (binary-safe object reads), then verified per entry by git blob, raw byte count and SHA-256 over the original blob bytes. No PowerShell text redirection was used to copy source.

fs-safe.mjs (blob 61bef04d51de884ac9eeb45d61eb5780e52b0c95, 1198 bytes) lives in the same pinned directory but is excluded from the CR-2 six-file whitelist; none of the six files import it, and it was not copied.
http.mjs is copied only because runProbe depends on assertContentType; this does not authorize calling httpsGet, which remains a real network entry and is never invoked by the CR-2 owner or tests.
The old probe CLI, original probe tests, TLS fixtures and certificates were not copied.
The six files form a closed import set: only relative imports among themselves plus node:https and node:crypto; no other local modules.
